tradition_hearth_and_harvest = {
	category = societal
	layers = {
		0 = steward
		1 = western
		4 = food.dds
	}
	is_shown = { has_cultural_pillar = heritage_halfling }
	can_pick = {
		OR = {
			this = culture:moonfoot_halfling
			any_parent_culture_or_above = { this = culture:moonfoot_halfling }
		}
	}
	parameters = {
		aov_unlock_maa_hearth_muster = yes
	}
	character_modifier = {
		levy_reinforcement_rate = 0.15
	}
	county_modifier = {
		development_growth_factor = 0.1
	}
	cost = {
		prestige = {
			add = {
				value = tradition_base_cost
				desc = BASE
				format = "BASE_VALUE_FORMAT"
			}
			multiply = tradition_replacement_cost_if_relevant
		}
	}
	ai_will_do = { value = 100 }
}
